query: I spent this morning planting a new row of cherry tomato seedlings in my backyard container garden, I even picked up a cute little terracotta plant marker to label them so I don’t mix them up with the basil I put in last week. The forecast says there might be a light drizzle tomorrow, so I’m a little worried the seedlings might get knocked over before their roots take hold, I might go out later to prop some small wooden stakes next to them just to be safe. Oh right, the reason I called is that I can’t make or receive any calls or use mobile data on my phone right now. I noticed airplane mode is turned on, but even when I toggle it off nothing works, could you check if my line is suspended because of an overdue bill?
